part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"attempt a ParaReal-style coarse predictor-corrector to parallelize across time steps","reason":"ParaReal computes multiple time steps concurrently, removing the step-after-step time dependency so more GPUs buy shorter single-trajectory wall-clock."},{"index":2,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Run many independent chains across GPUs, vectorize the log-likelihood over particles","reason":"Independent chains and vectorized likelihoods run side by side; each chain's step t still waits on step t-1."},{"index":3,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"no sequential chain exists between ligands","reason":"Independent ligands are screened side by side; there is no step-after-step dependency to remove."},{"index":4,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"run several independent searches whose best trees are merged to shorten the serial search path","reason":"Independent searches and parallel site likelihoods run side by side; each search's next move still depends on the prior accepted tree."},{"index":5,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"test whether member-level parallelism hides the serial cycle and whether an asynchronous ensemble filter reduces wall-clock","reason":"Members run as independent copies; the async filter removes member synchronization barriers, not the cycle's step-after-step dependency."}]}
